description: Land Acquisition - Makuluwa, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific plots of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels, their locations, extents, and current occupants/claimants. The content focuses entirely on land matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
